title: AVSplat: Dense-View Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Assist-View Preconditioning
abstract: arXiv:2609.05925v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting enables novel view synthesis from uncalibrated multi-view images. Although more views should improve performance, existing methods often degrade with dense-view inputs because global aggregation spreads attention over many tokens, and naive voxel fusion averages many Gaussians into overly smooth representations. We present AVSplat, a framework that turns additional views into reliable signals for both aggregation and representation. Before global attention, each view performs a single lightweight interaction with a small set of Assist Views chosen for relevance and diversity, and the cached features provide a focused scene context that stabilizes correspondence. For representation, we use adaptive temperature-aware voxel fusion that sharpens attribution under high occupancy, guided by occupancy and point confidence. Crucially, AVSplat restores positive view scaling where performance remains

translated_title: AVSplat：基于辅助视图预条件的密集视图前馈3D高斯泼溅
translated_abstract: 无位姿前馈3D高斯泼溅技术能够从未标定的多视图图像中进行新视角合成。尽管更多的视图理应提升性能，但现有方法在密集视图输入下常常出现性能退化，这是因为全局聚合将注意力分散到大量token上，而朴素的体素融合会将许多高斯平均为过度平滑的表示。我们提出了AVSplat，一个将额外视图转化为可用于聚合和表示的可靠信号的框架。在全局注意力之前，每个视图与根据相关性和多样性选择的小型辅助视图集合进行一次轻量级交互，缓存的特征提供了聚焦的场景上下文，从而稳定对应关系。在表示方面，我们使用自适应温度感知体素融合，在占用率和点置信度的引导下，在高占用情况下锐化归因。至关重要的是，AVSplat恢复了积极的视图缩放特性，使性能保持……
tldr: AVSplat通过辅助视图预条件机制和自适应温度感知体素融合，解决了现有前馈3D高斯泼溅方法在密集视图输入下性能退化的问题，使额外视图真正成为提升新视角合成质量的可靠信号。
en_tdlr: AVSplat resolves the performance degradation of pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting on dense-view inputs by introducing assist-view preconditioning and adaptive temperature-aware voxel fusion, turning additional views into reliable signals for improved novel view synthesis.
